headline: Oil Falls To 101.72 From 103.27, Down 1.5 Percent
narrative: Oil fell to 101.72 from 103.27, a 1.5 percent decline. The oil pipe is the cash price of crude, so the lower print means crude cash value fell against the prior reading. Gold is at 4,010.5, up 0.06 percent, and silver is at 54.24, up 0.98 percent, so bullion is higher while crude is lower.
author: jordan
